name: LineFormat
description: Represents line and arrowhead formatting. For a line, the LineFormat object contains formatting information for the line itself; for a shape with a border, this object contains formatting information for the shape's border.
remarks: Use the Line property to return a LineFormat object. The following example adds a blue, dashed line to the active document. There is a short, narrow oval at the line's starting point and a long, wide triangle at its endpoint.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified LineFormat object.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the background color for a patterned line. Read/write.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadLength.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadStyle.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadWidth.

properties.name: DashStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the dash style for the specified line. Read/write MsoLineDashStyle.

properties.name: EndArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadLength.

properties.name: EndArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadStyle.

properties.name: EndArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadWidth.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the line. Read/write.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that represents the pattern applied to the specified line. Read/write MsoPatternType.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the line format style. Read/write MsoLineStyle.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of line. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object, or the formatting applied to it, is visible. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Weight
properties.description: Returns or sets the thickness of the specified line in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: InsetPen
properties.description: MsoTrue to draw lines inside a specified shape. Read/write MsoTriState.
